statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_log (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  workflow_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_id TEXT,
  verdict TEXT NOT NULL,           
  duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  target TEXT,
  kbdb_rows_written INTEGER,       
  kbdb_rows_read INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL      
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_execution_log_workflow ON execution_log (workflow_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_execution_log_owner_created ON execution_log (owner_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_log_usage (
  day TEXT PRIMARY KEY,            
  writes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_log_retention_config (
  owner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  retention_days INTEGER,          
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
